concerns.text: T005 (Implement asymptotic_baseline.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on the output of T005b ('Read the verified formula from docs/verified_formula.md'). T005b is also marked [P]. This creates a hidden ordering violation: T005 cannot run until T005b completes, yet the [P] tag implies they can run in parallel. T005b must precede T005.

T011 (Implement generate_partitions.py) is marked [P] but explicitly requires T008 (Generate Reference Data) and T005b (Reference-Validator Step) to be complete. T011 loads 'tests/data/reference_values.csv' (produced by T008) and 'docs/verified_formula.md' (produced by T005b). The [P] tag is incorrect as T011 is a strict consumer of artifacts from T008 and T005b.

T016a (Implement feature_engineering.py) is marked [P] but requires T012 (data export from US1) to be complete. T016a loads 'data/raw/partitions_raw.csv' produced by T012. The [P] tag is invalid as T016a cannot execute until the US1 data artifact exists.

T024 (Implement CV logic) is marked [P] but explicitly states '(Depends on T022 passing)' and 'Requires T017c completion'. T022 is a test task, and T017c is the implementation of p-value correction. T024 cannot run in parallel with T017c or before T022 passes. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T001b is marked [P] but the description states 'Requires T001a completion'. While T001a and T001b are both in Phase 1, the explicit dependency means they cannot be truly parallel if T001b needs the directory structure created by T001a. The [P] tag should be removed or the dependency clarified as 'sequential within setup'.
